notes.title: Fretless - The Wrath of Riffson, release note for patch 3, build 19804628
notes.content:
[b]Fixed issues, new content[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed the passive of the RCA-TT-ACK monster
[*] Fixed descriptions for 8 String crescendo (from 20 damage per input to 2 damage per input)
[*] More fixes for battle not ending
[*] Fix for the Carbon Copy mod softlock if it tries to copy an empty slot
[*] Fix for fighting Oboe-A-Constrictor softlock when using Sapphire Skies Pedal
[*] Various English and French typo fixes
[*] Improved Rebinding on controller

[*] The wolves cutscene can fail to end (relaunching the game solves it)

[/list]

notes.title: Fretless is coming to PC this Summer
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We wanted to share an important update regarding Fretless. 

As you know, the release of Fretless is scheduled for next week.
We've made the decision to postpone the launch: Fretless will now release this Summer. 

This wasn't a decision we took lightly, but it's one we made with care-we need those extra weeks to polish the game, tune in our guitars, and ensure Fretless delivers the quality and creativity we know it's capable of, reflecting its full potential. 
We firmly believe that this delay will result in a significantly better experience for players. 

The Battle of the Bands will be ready to welcome you and hear your best and strongest riffs by then. 

We thank you for your understanding and continued support. 


Ritual Studios and Playdigious.

notes.title: The Fretless OST Vinyl is coming this Summer. Pre-order it now!
notes.content:
The official Fretless Vinyl is coming this Summer and  available for pre-order now!
King Yosef and Ola Englund round off the list of artists already announced alongside Northlane, Andrew Huang, Davie504, Cult of Luna, Rabea Massaad, Yvette Young and Mary Spender.

[url=https://www.g4f-records.com/en/produit/fretless-the-wrath-of-riffson-vinyl-edition/]Players can pre-order the Vinyl directly on G4F records ![/url]


[previewyoutube=8JBAKszv1GI;full][/previewyoutube]



[h2]Meet our latest guests : King Yosef and Ola Englund[/h2]

King Yosef is a producer, vocalist, and multi-instrumentalist from Portland, Oregon, known for fusing the aggression of industrial and metal with the emotional rawness of hip-hop and punk. Emerging from the underground scene, he gained recognition through 
collaborations with artists like Youth Code and his work with the late rapper XXXTentacion, helping define a gritty, genre-defying aesthetic.

In Fretless, King Yosef has composed the theme of the HarperBeast, a musical flying monster waiting for you in the crystal caves.


Ola Englund is a Swedish guitarist, producer, and 
content creator best known for his work in the metal scene and his role as a modern ambassador for heavy music. As the founder of the bands Feared and The Haunted, and the creator behind the gear-focused YouTube channel, he’s become a respected figure both onstage and online. Englund’s playing is rooted in groove-heavy, riff-driven metal, blending melodic sensibility with tight, aggressive rhythms and technical precision.


Find Ola Englund’s music in Fretless during the battle against the Auxarachnid, a bass-powered giant spider lurking in the Dissonant Thicket.

notes.title: Say hi to our special demo guest: Davie504!
notes.content:
Bass heads also get a special surprise for Steam Next Fest with Davie504 joining Fretless as an NPC and OST guest! 

Combining slapping humor with highly technical skills, Italy-based Davie504 has become one of YouTube's most prolific bass players, accumulating more than 14 million subscribers over the years. His meme culture-inspired musical skits, combined with snappy musical reviews, have shined a new light on the often-overlooked art of bass. 



Come meet him in Harmony Heights. He might greet you with a bass solo. "Settlement," the OST single featuring Davie504, is [url=https://idol-io.ffm.to/settlement-fromfretless]available now on all listening platforms[/url]! 

[previewyoutube=9j9UJtDni-Q;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The new demo is available now!
notes.content:
Our new demo is available now! 

Explore the first world of Fretless entirely in an updated demo! 
Venture into the new Dissonant Thicket area to encounter its boss, the vibrant Auxarachnid, waiting to catch you on its web. 
Hit the new rhythm-based QTEs in battle to maximize riff efficiency and beat your enemies with sick solos and crescendos! 
Customize your musical adventure with new mods to add to your instruments and new riffs to play on your bass and acoustic guitars!


NEW FEATURES: 

- New boss fight: cross riffs with the Auxarachnid in the Dissonant Thicket
- New QTE system: stay on the beat to out-solo your foes
- New riffs and mods to customize your adventure: add depth to your bass and swing to your acoustic guitar to beat musical monsters and goons
- New tutorialization: learn Fretless' mechanics and riff systems at your own pace, step by step. 

Get ready to rock this weekend!

notes.title: Learn more about music in Fretless with Jeff... and Jeff!
notes.content:
Fretless' combat system is centered around music: guitars are weapons, and melody is power! As you choose your instrument, you'll have to select your favorite riffs to defeat your enemies in awesome music battles. 

How does it work behind the scenes? How do you create music-centered combats that are exciting to hear and interesting to play? 

As part of Save&Sound week, Fretless' music composers Jeff and Jeff have produced an audio deep-dive explaining the game's particular battle system and how music is created. Discover everything from the tools they use on our Steam page Broadcast! 

Feel the music in real-time by downloading the demo today and make sure to wishlist the game to get the full experience in 2024 🤘

If you wanna know more about the game, make sure to follow our [url=https://playdigious.us11.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=246970b808d5051970062b6f1&id=08b1fdee07]newsletter[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Playdigious]X[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@playdigiousoff]TikTok[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Playdigious]YouTube[/url].

notes.title: Playdigious Originals presents Ritual Studios musical adventure: Fretless!
notes.content:
Playdigious has announced during the Future Games Show its new publishing arm, Playdigious Originals. The new publishing structure is partnering with Ritual Studios to launch Fretless - The Wrath of Riffson , as first title. Fretless is a pixel-art journey set in the vibrant and diverse musical rock world inspired by musician and content creator Rob Scallon. The game is an RPG adventure with turn-based combat set to launch in 2024.


Fretless - The Wrath of Riffson is one of the flagship titles under the Playdigious Originals label, embodying the spirit of creativity, passion, and artistic expression that the label stands for. Through Playdigious Originals, the company is excited to continue championing indie games and contributing to the thriving indie game development community.

To learn more about Fretless - The Wrath of Riffson and stay updated on its progress, please visit the Steam page follow Playdigious Originals on [url=https://twitter.com/Playdigious]Twitter[/url] and join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/playdigious]Discord[/url]!
